in_hebrew.name: טדאו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טדאו הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו 'מתנה אלוהים' או 'שנת אל'. השם נגזר מהמילים 'תד' ו-'אלוהים' או 'אל', שפירושם מתנה וישוע, בהתאמה. השם טדאו מופיע בתנ'ך כ'תדי' או 'תדו', שמות של דמויות שונות, אך המשמעות נשארת קשורה למתנה אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Ταδδεο
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Ταδδεο είναι η ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Θαδδαιος, που σημαίνει 'δοδω τω Θεω' ή 'δώρο του Θεού'. Το όνομα αυτό συναντάται στη Καινή Διαθήκη ως όνομα ενός από τους δώδεκα αποστόλους του Ιησού Χριστού, του Θαδδαίου. Η σημασία του ονόματος συνδέεται με την έννοια του δώρου του Θεού και της πνευματικής προσφοράς.

in_latin.name: Taddeo
in_latin.long_meaning: Taddeo, seu Taddeus, est nomen Latinum quod significat 'Donatio Dei' vel 'datum a Deo'. Nomen hoc derivatum est ex Hebraeo et Graeco, et in traditione Christiana primitiva invenitur. Significatio nominis est donum Dei, quod refertur ad notionem spiritualem et divinam.

in_english.name: Taddeo
in_english.long_meaning: Taddeo is a Christian name derived from Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying 'gift of God' or 'divine gift'. The name appears in various forms across biblical and historical contexts, often associated with Saint Jude Thaddeus, one of Jesus Christ's twelve apostles. The name embodies spiritual significance, symbolizing a divine gift or blessing. Throughout Christian tradition, Taddeo has been used to signify a child as a precious gift from God.

biblical_reference.note: The name Taddeus or Thaddeus is mentioned in the New Testament as one of Jesus' twelve apostles, often identified with Jude.

saint_reference.note: Saint Jude Thaddeus, also known as Taddeus, was one of Jesus' twelve apostles and is revered as the patron saint of hopeless causes.

data.cultural_impact: Taddeo is a name with deep historical and religious roots, borrowed from the biblical personality of Judas Thaddaeus or Judas the Tassel. Judas is intricately intertwined with Christianity as one of the twelve apostles who followed and supported Jesus Christ. The name Taddeo celebrates this rich heritage and the enduring influence of the faith in European cultures, particularly in Italy, from where the name is most commonly found.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Taddeo is rooted in its biblical origins. As a name associated with a chosen apostle, it evokes the concept of divine selection and the idea of being chosen by God. Taddeo is therefore a powerful reminder of one's personal connection to the divine and the call to belief, faith, and devotion. In addition, the name alludes to the idea of a gift from God, encouraging the holder to remember their purpose and use their talents and blessings for the greater good.

historical_references.reference: Taddeo d'Palermo, also known as Thaddeus of Palermo, was a 16th-century Sicilian painter. He is considered one of the leading artists of the Sicilian School and is known for his elaborate and richly decorated altarpieces. He was a contemporary of Caravaggio and was influenced by his works.

Saint Taddeus, also known as Thaddeus of Edessa or Lebanon, was one of the 12 Apostles of Jesus. He is traditionally considered to have been sent by Jesus to preach the Gospel in Armenia, Ethiopia, and Syria. He is considered a patron saint of Armenia and Ethiopia.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Taddeo, originally derived from the Hebrew Taddai meaning 'gift of God', has significant roots in Italian art and history as it was a common name among the Medici and Borghese families who were prominent patrons of the arts during the Renaissance period. Additionally, Taddeo is a notable name in Catholicism and Christianity, with several saints bearing this name. In a contemporary context, the name Taddeo is also used as a family name and is a subject of interest in genealogy research. One can find information about Taddeo on various platforms such as Wikipedia for historical and cultural context, LinkedIn for professional networking and genealogical research on Ancestry.com for family history.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Taddeo, a minister in Rome, Italy, shares that their name Taddeo meaning "Thaddeus, son of Jude" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Taddeo, meaning "gift of God," embodies the belief in divine providence and the idea that every person is a unique gift from the Creator. This name is a reminder that each individual has a special purpose in God's plan, and is infused with God's love and grace.
